# Optional Payroll Field Templates

ClearPath Payroll provides local software tools for payroll data entry and organization. It does not provide legal, tax, financial, accounting, or payroll compliance advice.

## What This Feature Does

Optional payroll field templates provide a catalog of common optional payroll field template records. A template becomes a user-defined field only after a user activates it for a company.

Templates are not activated automatically.

## Who Can Use It

Users with access to setup pages in the local ClearPath Payroll application.

## Steps

1. Open **Setup > Field Templates**.
2. Select a company.
3. Review the template catalog.
4. Select **Activate** for a template.
5. Open **Edit Activated Fields** to edit the field name or field code after activation.

## Included Templates

Department, job costing code, workers comp class, certified payroll classification, union code placeholder, project code, location code, tip amount, cash tips, reported tips, mileage reimbursement, PTO hours, sick hours, vacation hours, bonus amount, commission amount, piecework units, shift differential, garnishment placeholder, child support withholding placeholder, health insurance deduction, retirement deduction, and employer contribution placeholder.

## Required Permissions

Local setup access for the selected company.

## Common Errors

- No company selected.
- Template already activated for the company.
- Activated field code conflicts with an existing user-defined field.

## Cautions

Common optional payroll field template records are not guidance about payroll requirements. Do not store full SSNs, full bank account numbers, routing numbers, API keys, or secrets in activated custom fields.
